verses.text:
Come, bless the LORD,

all you servants of the LORD

who serve by night

in the house of the LORD!

Lift up your hands to the sanctuary

and bless the LORD!

May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth,

bless you from Zion.

text: Come, bless the LORD, all you servants of the LORD who serve by night in the house of the LORD! Lift up your hands to the sanctuary and bless the LORD! May the LORD, the Maker of heaven and earth, bless you from Zion.
